text: He paid ten thousand bitcoins... for two pizzas.
At bitcoin's peak? One point two six BILLION.
And he wasn't a newbie: he says he wrote the first GPU miner.
Four days after his offer, a California teenager had two large Papa John's delivered.
The pizzas cost the kid about twenty-five dollars.
And Laszlo? He made the same offer again.
Then he wrote: "I can't really afford to keep doing it."
In all, he says he spent about a hundred thousand bitcoins. Much of it on pizza.
Regrets? "You know, I don't regret it."
